resources.string: Up to 720p on Wi-Fi and 540p on cellular. Recommended.
On cellular, up to 360p and lighter audio.
Up to 360p and lighter audio on every network.
Calls adapt to the network either way and lower quality on a weak connection and in Low Data Mode. Changes apply at once, also during a call.
Connect directly whenever possible. Best quality.
Always via the server. Your IP address stays hidden.
A direct connection is usually faster, but the other person\'s device can see your IP address. Via the server, only the server\'s address is visible. Applies from the next call.
Directly only with people in Contacts. Everyone else via the server.
